pet_notes: Baby-stage Zéro. Preserve the approved low infant kitten morphology: huge rounded head, smaller visor with large innocent lime eyes, tiny bean-shaped body, four short paws, short thick black tail with attached lime orb. Exactly four limbs in every anatomical pose. Raised paw replaces its resting paw. Never revert to adult upright proportions.
style_notes: Hard-edged production pixel art matching the approved baby master. Limited warm cream, near-black and lime palette. No smoothing, no shadows, no detached effects, no anatomy duplication.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `pixel`: Pixel-art-adjacent digital mascot with a chunky silhouette, simple dark outline, limited palette, flat cel shading, and visible stepped edges.
